s3_object.description: The map with S3 object data of zip archive deployed (if deployment was from S3)

architectures.description: Instruction set architecture for your Lambda function. Valid values are ["x86_64"] and ["arm64"].

assume_role_policy_statements.description: Map of dynamic policy statements for assuming Lambda Function role (trust relationship)

attach_async_event_policy.description: Controls whether async event policy should be added to IAM role for Lambda Function

attach_cloudwatch_logs_policy.description: Controls whether CloudWatch Logs policy should be added to IAM role for Lambda Function

attach_create_log_group_permission.description: Controls whether to add the create log group permission to the CloudWatch logs policy

attach_dead_letter_policy.description: Controls whether SNS/SQS dead letter notification policy should be added to IAM role for Lambda Function

attach_network_policy.description: Controls whether VPC/network policy should be added to IAM role for Lambda Function

attach_policies.description: Controls whether list of policies should be added to IAM role for Lambda Function

attach_policy.description: Controls whether policy should be added to IAM role for Lambda Function

attach_tracing_policy.description: Controls whether X-Ray tracing policy should be added to IAM role for Lambda Function

authorization_type.description: The type of authentication that the Lambda Function URL uses. Set to 'AWS_IAM' to restrict access to authenticated IAM users only. Set to 'NONE' to bypass IAM authentication and create a public endpoint.

build_in_docker.description: Whether to build dependencies in Docker

cloudwatch_logs_deletion_protection_enab.description: Whether to enable deletion protection for the log group.

cloudwatch_logs_kms_key_id.description: The ARN of the KMS Key to use when encrypting log data.

cloudwatch_logs_log_group_class.description: Specified the log class of the log group. Possible values are: `STANDARD` or `INFREQUENT_ACCESS`

cloudwatch_logs_retention_in_days.description: Specifies the number of days you want to retain log events in the specified log group. Possible values are: 1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, and 3653.

cloudwatch_logs_skip_destroy.description: Whether to keep the log group (and any logs it may contain) at destroy time.

cloudwatch_logs_tags.description: A map of tags to assign to the resource.

code_signing_config_arn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for a Code Signing Configuration

compatible_architectures.description: A list of Architectures Lambda layer is compatible with. Currently x86_64 and arm64 can be specified.

compatible_runtimes.description: A list of Runtimes this layer is compatible with. Up to 5 runtimes can be specified.

cors.description: CORS settings to be used by the Lambda Function URL

create.description: Controls whether resources should be created

create_async_event_config.description: Controls whether async event configuration for Lambda Function/Alias should be created

create_current_version_allowed_triggers.description: Whether to allow triggers on current version of Lambda Function (this will revoke permissions from previous version because Terraform manages only current resources)

create_current_version_async_event_confi.description: Whether to allow async event configuration on current version of Lambda Function (this will revoke permissions from previous version because Terraform manages only current resources)

create_function.description: Controls whether Lambda Function resource should be created

create_lambda_function_url.description: Controls whether the Lambda Function URL resource should be created

create_layer.description: Controls whether Lambda Layer resource should be created

create_package.description: Controls whether Lambda package should be created

create_role.description: Controls whether IAM role for Lambda Function should be created

create_sam_metadata.description: Controls whether the SAM metadata null resource should be created

create_unqualified_alias_allowed_trigger.description: Whether to allow triggers on unqualified alias pointing to $LATEST version

create_unqualified_alias_async_event_con.description: Whether to allow async event configuration on unqualified alias pointing to $LATEST version

create_unqualified_alias_lambda_function.description: Whether to use unqualified alias pointing to $LATEST version in Lambda Function URL

dead_letter_target_arn.description: The ARN of an SNS topic or SQS queue to notify when an invocation fails.

description.description: Description of your Lambda Function (or Layer)

destination_on_failure.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the destination resource for failed asynchronous invocations

destination_on_success.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the destination resource for successful asynchronous invocations

docker_additional_options.description: Additional options to pass to the docker run command (e.g. to set environment variables, volumes, etc.)

docker_build_root.description: Root dir where to build in Docker

docker_entrypoint.description: Path to the Docker entrypoint to use

docker_file.description: Path to a Dockerfile when building in Docker

docker_image.description: Docker image to use for the build

docker_pip_cache.description: Whether to mount a shared pip cache folder into docker environment or not

docker_with_ssh_agent.description: Whether to pass SSH_AUTH_SOCK into docker environment or not

durable_config_execution_timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds for the durable function. Valid values between 1 and 31622400 (366 days).

durable_config_retention_period.description: Number of days to retain the function's execution state. Valid values between 1 and 90. Defaults to 14 if durable_config is enabled.

environment_variables.description: A map that defines environment variables for the Lambda Function.

ephemeral_storage_size.description: Amount of ephemeral storage (/tmp) in MB your Lambda Function can use at runtime. Valid value between 512 MB to 10,240 MB (10 GB).

file_system_arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon EFS Access Point that provides access to the file system.

file_system_local_mount_path.description: The path where the function can access the file system, starting with /mnt/.

function_name.description: A unique name for your Lambda Function

function_tags.description: A map of tags to assign only to the lambda function

handler.description: Lambda Function entrypoint in your code

hash_extra.description: The string to add into hashing function. Useful when building same source path for different functions.

ignore_source_code_hash.description: Whether to ignore changes to the function's source code hash. Set to true if you manage infrastructure and code deployments separately.

image_config_command.description: The CMD for the docker image

image_config_entry_point.description: The ENTRYPOINT for the docker image

image_config_working_directory.description: The working directory for the docker image

image_uri.description: The ECR image URI containing the function's deployment package.

include_default_tag.description: [Deprecated] Set to false to not include the default tag in the tags map.

invoke_mode.description: Invoke mode of the Lambda Function URL. Valid values are BUFFERED (default) and RESPONSE_STREAM.

ipv6_allowed_for_dual_stack.description: Allows outbound IPv6 traffic on VPC functions that are connected to dual-stack subnets

kms_key_arn.description: The ARN of KMS key to use by your Lambda Function

lambda_at_edge.description: Set this to true if using Lambda@Edge, to enable publishing, limit the timeout, and allow edgelambda.amazonaws.com to invoke the function

lambda_at_edge_logs_all_regions.description: Whether to specify a wildcard in IAM policy used by Lambda@Edge to allow logging in all regions

lambda_role.description: IAM role ARN attached to the Lambda Function. This governs both who / what can invoke your Lambda Function, as well as what resources our Lambda Function has access to. See Lambda Permission Model for more details.

layer_name.description: Name of Lambda Layer to create

layer_skip_destroy.description: Whether to retain the old version of a previously deployed Lambda Layer.

layers.description: List of Lambda Layer Version ARNs (maximum of 5) to attach to your Lambda Function.

license_info.description: License info for your Lambda Layer. Eg, MIT or full url of a license.

local_existing_package.description: The absolute path to an existing zip-file to use

logging_application_log_level.description: The application log level of the Lambda Function. Valid values are "TRACE", "DEBUG", "INFO", "WARN", "ERROR", or "FATAL".

logging_log_format.description: The log format of the Lambda Function. Valid values are "JSON" or "Text".

logging_log_group.description: The CloudWatch log group to send logs to.

logging_system_log_level.description: The system log level of the Lambda Function. Valid values are "DEBUG", "INFO", or "WARN".

maximum_event_age_in_seconds.description: Maximum age of a request that Lambda sends to a function for processing in seconds. Valid values between 60 and 21600.

maximum_retry_attempts.description: Maximum number of times to retry when the function returns an error. Valid values between 0 and 2. Defaults to 2.

memory_size.description: Amount of memory in MB your Lambda Function can use at runtime. Valid value between 128 MB to 10,240 MB (10 GB), in 64 MB increments.

number_of_policies.description: Number of policies to attach to IAM role for Lambda Function

number_of_policy_jsons.description: Number of policies JSON to attach to IAM role for Lambda Function

package_type.description: The Lambda deployment package type. Valid options: Zip or Image

policies.description: List of policy statements ARN to attach to Lambda Function role

policy.description: An additional policy document ARN to attach to the Lambda Function role

policy_json.description: An additional policy document as JSON to attach to the Lambda Function role

policy_jsons.description: List of additional policy documents as JSON to attach to Lambda Function role

policy_name.description: IAM policy name. It override the default value, which is the same as role_name

policy_statements.description: Map of dynamic policy statements to attach to Lambda Function role

provisioned_concurrent_executions.description: Amount of capacity to allocate. Set to 1 or greater to enable, or set to 0 to disable provisioned concurrency.

publish.description: Whether to publish creation/change as new Lambda Function Version.

putin_khuylo.description: Do you agree that Putin doesn't respect Ukrainian sovereignty and territorial integrity? More info: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Putin_khuylo!

quiet_archive_local_exec.description: Whether to disable archive local execution output

recreate_missing_package.description: Whether to recreate missing Lambda package if it is missing locally or not

recursive_loop.description: Lambda function recursion configuration. Valid values are Allow or Terminate.

region.description: Region where the resource(s) will be managed. Defaults to the region set in the provider configuration

replace_security_groups_on_destroy.description: (Optional) When true, all security groups defined in vpc_security_group_ids will be replaced with the default security group after the function is destroyed. Set the replacement_security_group_ids variable to use a custom list of security groups for replacement instead.

replacement_security_group_ids.description: (Optional) List of security group IDs to assign to orphaned Lambda function network interfaces upon destruction. replace_security_groups_on_destroy must be set to true to use this attribute.

reserved_concurrent_executions.description: The amount of reserved concurrent executions for this Lambda Function. A value of 0 disables Lambda Function from being triggered and -1 removes any concurrency limitations. Defaults to Unreserved Concurrency Limits -1.

role_description.description: Description of IAM role to use for Lambda Function

role_force_detach_policies.description: Specifies to force detaching any policies the IAM role has before destroying it.

role_maximum_session_duration.description: Maximum session duration, in seconds, for the IAM role

role_name.description: Name of IAM role to use for Lambda Function

role_path.description: Path of IAM role to use for Lambda Function

role_permissions_boundary.description: The ARN of the policy that is used to set the permissions boundary for the IAM role used by Lambda Function

role_tags.description: A map of tags to assign to IAM role

s3_acl.description: The canned ACL to apply. Valid values are private, public-read, public-read-write, aws-exec-read, authenticated-read, bucket-owner-read, and bucket-owner-full-control. Defaults to private.

s3_existing_package.description: The S3 bucket object with keys bucket, key, version pointing to an existing zip-file to use

s3_kms_key_id.description: Specifies a custom KMS key to use for S3 object encryption.

s3_object_override_default_tags.description: Whether to override the default_tags from provider? NB: S3 objects support a maximum of 10 tags.

s3_object_storage_class.description: Specifies the desired Storage Class for the artifact uploaded to S3. Can be either STANDARD, REDUCED_REDUNDANCY, ONEZONE_IA, INTELLIGENT_TIERING, or STANDARD_IA.

s3_object_tags.description: A map of tags to assign to S3 bucket object.

s3_object_tags_only.description: Set to true to not merge tags with s3_object_tags. Useful to avoid breaching S3 Object 10 tag limit.

s3_prefix.description: Directory name where artifacts should be stored in the S3 bucket. If unset, the path from `artifacts_dir` is used

s3_server_side_encryption.description: Specifies server-side encryption of the object in S3. Valid values are "AES256" and "aws:kms".

skip_destroy.description: Set to true if you do not wish the function to be deleted at destroy time, and instead just remove the function from the Terraform state. Useful for Lambda@Edge functions attached to CloudFront distributions.

snap_start.description: (Optional) Snap start settings for low-latency startups

source_path.description: The absolute path to a local file or directory containing your Lambda source code

store_on_s3.description: Whether to store produced artifacts on S3 or locally.

tags.description: A map of tags to assign to resources.

tenant_isolation_mode.description: Enable tenant isolation mode for the Lambda Function

timeout.description: The amount of time your Lambda Function has to run in seconds.

timeouts.description: Define maximum timeout for creating, updating, and deleting Lambda Function resources

tracing_mode.description: Tracing mode of the Lambda Function. Valid value can be either PassThrough or Active.

trigger_on_package_timestamp.description: Whether to recreate the Lambda package if the timestamp changes

trusted_entities.description: List of additional trusted entities for assuming Lambda Function role (trust relationship)

use_existing_cloudwatch_log_group.description: Whether to use an existing CloudWatch log group or create new

vpc_security_group_ids.description: List of security group ids when Lambda Function should run in the VPC.

vpc_subnet_ids.description: List of subnet ids when Lambda Function should run in the VPC. Usually private or intra subnets.

dlq_alarm_arn.description: ARN of the CloudWatch alarm monitoring the DLQ, or null if disabled.

lambda_env_full_return_table.description: Value of the FULL_RETURN_TABLE Lambda environment variable.

lambda_env_ignore_accounts.description: JSON-encoded value of the IGNORE_AWS_ACCOUNTS Lambda environment variable.

lambda_env_logging_level.description: Value of the LOGGING_LEVEL Lambda environment variable.

lambda_env_perform_deletions.description: Value of the PERFORM_ATTACHMENT_DELETIONS Lambda environment variable ('true' or 'false').

lambda_env_process_only_accounts.description: JSON-encoded value of the PROCESS_ONLY_AWS_ACCOUNTS Lambda environment variable.

lambda_env_segment_addressing_file.description: Value of the SEGMENT_ADDRESSING_FILE Lambda environment variable. Empty string when vpc_segment_address_map is not provided.

lambda_function_arn.description: ARN of the CloudWAN routing configuration Lambda function.

lambda_function_name.description: Name of the CloudWAN routing configuration Lambda function ({name}_{region}_routing).

lambda_routing_config_local_package.description: Local path of the built Lambda deployment package. Pass this value as lambda_routing_config_local_package when promoting the same artefact to a subsequent environment.

sns_filter_policy.description: JSON filter policy applied to the SNS subscription. Contains the coreUplinkArn list used to restrict events to the managed core network.

sns_subscription_arn.description: ARN of the SNS subscription that connects the network-events topic to the SQS queue.

sqs_dlq_name.description: Name of the dead-letter queue for attachment events that exhausted all retry attempts.

sqs_max_receive_count.description: Number of times a message is delivered before being sent to the DLQ (derived from the redrive policy).

sqs_queue_arn.description: ARN of the main SQS queue.

sqs_queue_delay_seconds.description: Seconds a message is delayed before becoming visible to consumers.

sqs_queue_name.description: Name of the main SQS queue that buffers CloudWAN attachment events.

sqs_queue_url.description: URL of the main SQS queue (also set as the SQS_URL Lambda environment variable).

sqs_queue_visibility_timeout_seconds.description: SQS visibility timeout in seconds. Must exceed the Lambda timeout (90 s) to prevent duplicate processing.

aws_account_reader_role_arn.description: ARN of the cross-account IAM role the Lambda assumes to read AWS Organizations account tags. The role must exist in the Organizations management account (or a delegated admin) and allow sts:AssumeRole from the Lambda's execution role.

cloudwan_quarantine_table.description: Name of the Cloud WAN segment used to isolate non-compliant VPC attachments. Attachments that fail validation (wrong CIDR, missing org tag) are tagged to this segment instead of being deleted when lambda_perform_attachment_deletion is false.

cloudwan_quarantineroutes_table.description: Name of the Cloud WAN segment used for quarantined attachment route learning. Routes from quarantined attachments are propagated here so operators can inspect them without affecting production routing tables.

cloudwan_route_domain_tag.description: Name of the AWS Organizations account tag that the Lambda reads to determine which Cloud WAN routing segment (domain) an account's VPC attachments should be placed in. The tag value must match a segment name in the core network policy.

cloudwatch_logs_retention_in_days.description: Number of days to retain Lambda CloudWatch log events. Set to a lower value (e.g. 7) in development environments and higher (e.g. 90) in production for compliance.

core_network_arn.description: ARN of the Cloud WAN core network managed by this module. When set, the SNS subscription filter policy restricts events to attachments belonging to this core network. When null, all attachment events from the topic are forwarded.

dlq_alarm_enabled.description: Whether to create a CloudWatch alarm for messages arriving in the dead-letter queue.

dlq_alarm_sns_topic_arn.description: ARN of an SNS topic to notify when the DLQ alarm fires. When null, the alarm is created but sends no notifications.

dlq_alarm_threshold.description: Number of messages in the DLQ that triggers the alarm.

full_return_table.description: Name of the Cloud WAN routing segment that contains the full set of known network routes. The Lambda queries this segment to detect overlapping CIDRs before accepting a new VPC attachment.

full_return_table_regions_suffixes.description:
Map of AWS region name → suffix string used to construct region-specific route table names within the
full-return segment. For example, {"eu-west-1": "_euw1"} allows the Lambda to look up
"fullreturn_euw1" when checking for conflicting routes in eu-west-1.

global_network_id.description: Network Manager global network ID. Passed to the Lambda as MANAGED_GLOBAL_NETWORK_ID; required for NetworkManager API calls that operate at global-network scope.

ignore_aws_accounts.description: List of AWS account IDs whose VPC attachment events should be silently ignored. Takes precedence over process_only_aws_accounts when both are set.

lambda_api_regions.description: AWS regions for which the Lambda creates regional NetworkManager API clients. Include every region where VPC attachments may be created.

lambda_logging_level.description: Logging verbosity for the Lambda function. WARN is suitable for production; INFO adds per-attachment decisions; DEBUG includes full API payloads.

lambda_perform_attachment_deletion.description: Allow the Lambda to delete non-compliant VPC attachments. When false, non-compliant attachments are moved to the quarantine segment instead of being deleted — useful during initial roll-out or troubleshooting.

lambda_reserved_concurrent_executions.description: Maximum number of concurrent Lambda invocations. Set to null for unlimited. A low value (e.g. 1) ensures sequential processing which avoids race conditions on attachment state.

lambda_routing_config_local_package.description: Path to a pre-built Lambda deployment package (.zip). When provided, the module skips building the package from source and deploys this file directly. Useful for promoting the same artefact across environments.

lambda_runtime.description: Python runtime identifier for the Lambda function. Defaults to python3.13.

name.description: Base name applied to all resources created by this module (SQS queues, Lambda function).

network_events_sns_topic_arn.description: ARN of the SNS topic that publishes Cloud WAN attachment lifecycle events. The module subscribes an SQS queue to this topic.

network_events_sns_topic_deployment_role.description: IAM role name used by the CI/CD pipeline to manage the SNS topic. Referenced for documentation purposes; not directly used by Terraform resources in this module.

network_events_sns_topic_region.description: AWS region where the network-events SNS topic lives. Used when the topic is in a different region from the Lambda (common in centralised-networking designs).

process_only_aws_accounts.description: Allowlist of AWS account IDs to process. When non-empty, the Lambda skips attachment events from any account not in this list. Useful for phased roll-outs.

region.description: AWS region in which SQS queues and the Lambda function are created. Defaults to the region of the configured AWS provider.

region_sns_topic_subscription.description: Region passed to the aliased aws.aws_sns_subscribe provider when creating the SNS subscription. Must match network_events_sns_topic_region when the topic is cross-region.

routing_policy_tag_delay_seconds.description: Seconds the Lambda waits after an attachment becomes AVAILABLE before applying the routing-policy tag. A short delay avoids race conditions where the attachment transitions state immediately after becoming available.

routing_policy_tag_vpc_marker.description: Value written to the routing-policy tag when the Lambda accepts a VPC attachment. Identifies the attachment as a regular VPC in Cloud WAN routing policies.

sqs_delay_seconds.description: Delay in seconds before a message delivered to the SQS queue becomes visible to the Lambda. A non-zero value can absorb transient Cloud WAN state-propagation delays.
